angle: DL/EDGE: pass-rush-drill get-off burst and Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G), year-standardized, followed along a chain (drill repeatability -> NFL get-off / first-second burst / bend on sampled rushes -> career pressure rate); baseline = log pick + weight + EDGE share + NGS athleticism + official 10-yd split + 3-cone, leave-one-class-out; six pre-listed drill measures tested jointly with a family-wise permutation; day-3 decision test at rusher level
metric_name: Hoop G: at the tightest half-second of the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight, speed squared over turn radius in g, z within Combine year (contrast: rush-drill burst, yards in the first second of the pass-rush drill)
headline_number: Held out (n=77): Hoop G +1.8 pressures per 450-rush season per sd [0.2, 3.4], p=0.03 alone but family-wise p=0.23 across six drill measures (chance max +/-2.4); burst -0.5 [-2.3, 1.3], equivalence p=0.06. Chain: NGS get-off -> pressure 0.41 but drill burst -> NGS get-off -0.14 (one rep repeats at 0.13). Day 3 (47 rushers, each once): forecast+Hoop G rank rho 0.29 vs draft order 0.01 (gap 0.28 [0.03, 0.53]), but top-third hit 9 of 15 for both.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of the DL Hoop G line (round 19 cand_1, 7.83) aimed at its three fatal flaws. (1) 'Chosen after screening': six drill measures (3 per drill) are listed and tested together with a joint within-class permutation; Hoop G is reported with its family-wise p (0.23) and the headline now says it does not survive the screen. (2) 'Non-independent pairs': the 125-pair tie rule is removed; every decision test is rusher-level (47 day-3 rushers, each once) with class-stratified bootstrap intervals and an out-of-class Hoop G weight. (3) 'Not better than coin or draft order': stated plainly (top-third 9 of 15 vs 9 of 15); recommendation narrowed to film order, never board order. Also: bold plain-words lede, coach-repeatable Hoop G definition (speed^2/radius, 3.5 yd/s on a 1.8-yd radius), reliability + drill-to-NFL + NFL-to-pressure merged in one chain table, results-carrying headings, sensitivity cut to one sentence, analysis.py cut from 1,232 to ~900 lines, body 1,627 words, 4 figures + 2 tables.
open_risks: Headline is a null after the six-measure correction (family-wise p=0.23); judges may score Football low for a non-actionable finding
